about_the_game:
Paper Xian

A xianxia-themed roguelike survival action game combining Brotato's fast-paced combat with classic roguelike progression, featuring a unique paper-cut art style. Play as a cultivator defending against 20 waves of demonic beasts by mastering abilities, joining sects, and enhancing stats.

▶ This Demo includes approximately 1 hour of gameplay, featuring:

  • 4 playable characters

  • 11 challenging stages

  • The full version unlocks all 20 stages, the Spirit Pet system, plus additional characters, items, skills, and sects.

▶ Core Gameplay

  • Paper-cut xianxia world: Characters and environments crafted in intricate 3D paper art.

  • Multiple heroes: Diverse playstyles with unique growth paths.

  • Sect allegiance: Join righteous or demonic sects for exclusive skills and techniques.

  • Auto-combat: Move to dodge while abilities auto-target enemies—easy to play!

  • Local co-op: Team up with a friend in 2-player mode.

Key Features
🌿 Survival Challenge

  • Spend spiritual essence post-wave to upgrade abilities, techniques, or stats.

  • Ability mastery: Repeated acquisition strengthens powers.

  • Technique tiers: Enhance attributes, accelerate growth, or unlock special effects.

🏯 Sect Legacy

  • Molten Rock Vale: Focus on defense/strength with powerful but costly techniques.

  • Void Sword Pavilion: Master ranged sword qi and mana efficiency.

  • More sects coming!

🕹️ Simple Controls, Deep Strategy

  • Move to survive—abilities auto-fire.

  • 30-minute runs with escalating 20-wave difficulty.

"Seek the Dao in paper, survive to ascend!" Defend against the demon tide in this papercraft cultivation world.

More heroes, abilities, techniques, and items coming soon—Wishlist now!
